title: e-component instance node — component-instance envelope with one plain override, schema_source.id === component_id
_comment: SPEC 2.0 (components controller WP) — the native instance wire shape verified against Elementor 4.2.1 (modules/components/prop-types/component-instance-prop-type.php): settings.component_instance is a {"$$type":"component-instance"} envelope whose value carries component_id (number envelope) and overrides (overrides array envelope of override items). The INVARIANT under test: every override's schema_source.id must equal component_id (the server rejects the whole prop otherwise). A dangling component_id (no such component on the fixture site) is VALID by design — Component_Override_Parser::validate_override treats a missing component as the deleted-props scenario and accepts (the envelope shape is what is validated). Requires the e_components module (Elementor 4.2+, e_components + e_atomic_elements experiments) for the e-component widget type to exist.
